facts.fact: Developed using UK Biobank plasma proteomics; the original paper summary describes elastic-net organ-specific and conventional models using proteomic data from over 50,000 UK Biobank participants and other cohorts. Olink Explore 3072 assayed approximately 3,000 proteins.
facts.locator: Original Cell Metabolism paper, Summary and Introduction; author's Olink Explore 3072 model guidance

facts.fact: The accessible paper summary and author README do not identify a precise training age interval or model-specific fitted sample count for this coefficient variant; no more specific value is inferred. The author README recommends full models and first fold for new Olink Explore 3072 data.
facts.locator: Original-author README, How to apply the organ-specific models to your own dataset; source limit for this pass

review_notes: All 40 requested metadata records were checked against the methods audit, current clock metadata, and original-author evidence ledger. Per-record OrganAge identity was checked by clock name, target family, coefficient-backed n_features, output unit and DOI; the records share one original paper but do not share age-versus-mortality targets.

For OrganAge, chronological variants predict age in years with elastic-net regression; mortality variants predict relative natural-log mortality hazard with Cox elastic-net. No mortality-to-years conversion or age-gap calculation is implied by the registered mortality variants. The author README explicitly recommends full models and fold 1 for Olink Explore 3072, matching pinned build provenance.

PAC remains a mortality-surrogate age in years. Its input includes age and 128 proteins; it is not a chronological-age residual. The exact-DOI citation snapshot association and count were retained for both publications (OrganAge 128; PAC 68, observed 2026-10-02).

The pinned original PAC R file was fetched and checked live. The OrganAge author's current repository README was checked live, along with the published paper landing-page summary. The complete OrganAge paper/supplement coefficient tables were not extracted in this pass; see the unresolved item. No MethylCIPHER or Biolearn source was used.
The citation count is a dated snapshot and is retained only as of 2026-10-02. No data, model, notebook, or metadata registry files were changed.
